title: Investment Opportunity and Development Prospect of China Liquor Industry, 2013
主要内容: In 2012, the liquor industry achieved sales revenue of CNY 446.625 billion, up 19.21% year-on-year, and total profit of CNY 81.856 billion, up 48.52% year-on-year. The market concentration ratio was still low, with 1,290 enterprises above designated scale, of which 66.8% were private and 84.92% were small-sized. The industry faced shocks from economic weakness and policy changes, with high-end liquor prices decreasing to boost sales.
